```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)

# 1. Read burdekin.csv skipping the 4 WMIP header rows and removing the 2 footer lines
burdekin_clean <- read_csv(
  here("data", "raw", "burdekin.csv"),
  skip = 4,
  col_names = FALSE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(str_detect(X1, "^\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}")) %>%
  transmute(
    date = dmy_hms(X1) %>% as_date(),
    level_m = as.numeric(X2),
    level_qual = as.numeric(X3),
    discharge_ML_day = as.numeric(X14),
    discharge_qual = as.numeric(X15),
    ec_us_cm = as.numeric(X22),
    ec_qual = as.numeric(X23),
    water_temp_c = as.numeric(X28)
  ) %>%
  filter(discharge_qual <= 130)

# 2. Calculate pre-flood baseline (Nov-Dec 2023 90th percentile) & flood recovery days
baseline_q90 <- burdekin_clean %>%
  filter(month(date) %in% c(11, 12)) %>%
  summarise(q90 = quantile(discharge_ML_day, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(q90)

peak_date <- burdekin_clean %>%
  slice_max(discharge_ML_day, n = 1) %>%
  pull(date)

recovery_date <- burdekin_clean %>%
  filter(date > peak_date, discharge_ML_day <= baseline_q90) %>%
  slice_min(date, n = 1) %>%
  pull(date)

cat("Peak Flood Date:", as.character(peak_date), "\n")
cat("Return-to-Baseline Date:", as.character(recovery_date), "\n")
cat("Freshwater Pulse Duration:", as.numeric(recovery_date - peak_date), "days\n")

```


Incorporating Mod 2: R for Marine Science Techniqes into Workflow
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

# Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette
pal_okabe <- c(
  "Pre-Flood Baseline"   = "#0072B2",
  "Active Flood Plume"   = "#D55E00",
  "Post-Flood Recovery"  = "#009E73",
  "Sensor Dropout"       = "#CC79A7"
)

# 1. Import & clean QLD WMIP burdekin.csv (Burdekin River at Clare, using hms_dmy for "00:00:00 01/11/2023" format)
burdekin <- read_csv(
  here("data", "raw", "burdekin.csv"),
  skip = 4,
  col_names = FALSE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(str_detect(X1, "^\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}")) %>%
  transmute(
    date             = hms_dmy(X1) %>% as_date(),
    level_m          = as.numeric(X2),
    level_qual       = as.numeric(X3),
    discharge_ML_day = as.numeric(X14),
    discharge_qual   = as.numeric(X15),
    ec_us_cm         = as.numeric(X22),
    ec_qual          = as.numeric(X23),
    water_temp_c     = as.numeric(X28)
  ) %>%
  filter(discharge_qual <= 130)


# 2. Enforce complete daily grid & flag non-random EC sensor dropouts
burdekin_ts <- burdekin %>%
  complete(date = seq.Date(min(date, na.rm = TRUE), max(date, na.rm = TRUE), by = "day")) %>%
  mutate(
    ec_status        = if_else(is.na(ec_us_cm), "Sensor Dropout (Peak Flow)", "Valid Telemetry"),
    discharge_ML_day = coalesce(discharge_ML_day, 0)
  )

# Quick check: should show 183 rows from 2023-11-01 to 2024-05-01
glimpse(burdekin_ts)
```


```{r}

# 3. Quantify dry-season baseline (Nov-Dec 2023 Q90) & dissipation duration
baseline_q90 <- burdekin_ts %>%
  filter(month(date) %in% c(11, 12)) %>%
  summarise(q90 = quantile(discharge_ML_day, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(q90)

peak_row <- burdekin_ts %>% slice_max(discharge_ML_day, n = 1)
peak_date <- peak_row$date

recovery_date <- burdekin_ts %>%
  filter(date > peak_date, discharge_ML_day <= baseline_q90) %>%
  slice_min(date, n = 1) %>%
  pull(date)

dissipation_days <- as.numeric(recovery_date - peak_date)


```

```{r}
# 4. Classify hydrological phases for group summaries & plotting
burdekin_phases <- burdekin_ts %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      date < ymd("2024-01-25") ~ "Pre-Flood Baseline",
      date >= ymd("2024-01-25") & date <= recovery_date ~ "Active Flood Plume",
      TRUE ~ "Post-Flood Recovery"
    ),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Pre-Flood Baseline", "Active Flood Plume", "Post-Flood Recovery"))
  )

# Summary table for your slide or Quarto report
phase_summary <- burdekin_phases %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    days = n(),
    median_discharge_ML = round(median(discharge_ML_day, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    max_discharge_ML    = round(max(discharge_ML_day, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    mean_temp_c         = round(mean(water_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    ec_missing_pct      = round(mean(is.na(ec_us_cm)) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(phase_summary)


```

```{r}
# 5. Panel A: Discharge Hydrograph & Plume Dissipation Window
p_hydro <- ggplot(burdekin_phases, aes(x = date, y = discharge_ML_day / 1000)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = peak_date, xmax = recovery_date,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(color = phase, group = 1), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline_q90 / 1000, linetype = "dashed", color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = recovery_date + days(4),
    y = max(burdekin_phases$discharge_ML_day) / 1000 * 0.85,
    label = paste0("Dissipation Window:\n", dissipation_days, " days to baseline"),
    hjust = 0, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", color = "#D55E00"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_okabe, name = "Hydrological Phase") +
  labs(
    title = "A. Burdekin River Freshwater Pulse & Dissipation Timeline (Station 120006B)",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = Nov–Dec dry-season 90th percentile baseline threshold",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Discharge (Thousand ML / day)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# 6. Panel B: Electrical Conductivity & Flood-Induced Sensor Dropout
p_ec <- ggplot(burdekin_phases, aes(x = date, y = ec_us_cm)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = phase), size = 2, alpha = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_rug(
    data = filter(burdekin_phases, is.na(ec_us_cm)),
    aes(x = date), sides = "b", color = "#CC79A7", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_okabe, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "B. Specific Conductance & Peak-Flood Telemetry Dropout",
    subtitle = "Pink bottom ticks mark missing EC telemetry during high-flow sediment loading",
    x = "Date (2023–2024 Wet Season)",
    y = expression(Conductivity~(mu*S~cm^-1))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# Combine & export high-res figure for PowerPoint
final_fig <- p_hydro / p_ec
ggsave(
  here("outputs", "figures", "Burdekin_Mod2_Dissipation.png"),
  final_fig, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300
)


```
